Published legacy talent: sweep three contiguous threatened squares. The weapon deals damage; creatures no larger than the dragoon risk being knocked prone.

target.value: all creatures in three adjacent threatened squares

effect: Hits friend or foe. Larger creatures take damage but cannot be knocked prone. The legacy use limit is 3 + Strength modifier.

description.value: An orc remains conscious and can continue fighting even if its hit points total is below 0. It is still staggered and loses 1 hit point each round. A creature with ferocity still dies when its hit points total reaches a negative amount equal to its Constitution score.

effect: Below 0 HP remain conscious but staggered and lose 1 HP per round; death at negative Constitution.

description.value: Hardy Landing

effect: Treat the fall as 20 feet shorter for falling damage.

description.value: Pole Fighting

effect: Switch to the short grip for adjacent enemies; another immediate action restores normal reach.
Legacy short grip: -4 to the normal longspear roll while fighting adjacent targets.

description.value: Deadly Lancer

effect: After a qualifying jump of at least 10 feet. The additional dice are not multiplied on critical hits.
